title: Flatness criterion for a cokernel
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $T$ a scheme, with small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_T$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Let $\mathcal K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of $\Lambda_T$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and let $a\in\mathbf Z$. Assume that $H^n(\mathcal K^\bullet\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal M)=0$ for every $\Lambda_T$-module sheaf $\mathcal M$ placed in degree $0$ and every $n<a$, where tensor denotes the ordinary total tensor complex [def-kun-derived-tensor] and $H^n$ is its cohomology sheaf [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]. Then $\mathcal N=\operatorname{coker}(\mathcal K^{a-1}\to\mathcal K^a)$, taken in the abelian category of module sheaves, is a flat $\Lambda_T$-module sheaf.

proof.text: For every module sheaf $\mathcal M$, take $n=a-1<a$ in the hypothesis. By [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules], $H^{a-1}=\ker d^{a-1}/\operatorname{im}d^{a-2}$ in the abelian category of module sheaves. Its vanishing says precisely $\operatorname{im}d^{a-2}=\ker d^{a-1}$, so $\mathcal K^\bullet\otimes_\Lambda\mathcal M$ is exact in degree $a-1$.

source.place: ## Proof, first paragraph: vanishing of H^{a-1} and exactness

proof.text: Work with the small-site representative of $T_{\Et}$ fixed by [def-weil-size-convention]. In [lem-weil-pbc-site-flat-opcycles-tor-criterion], set $\mathcal O=\Lambda_T$, $P^\bullet=\mathcal K^\bullet$, and $n=a$. For $\mathcal M[0]$, the totalization formula of [def-kun-derived-tensor] has just $\mathcal K^j\otimes_{\Lambda_T}\mathcal M$ in degree $j$ and differential $d_{\mathcal K}^j\otimes1$. The cited symmetry has sign $(-1)^{j\cdot0}=1$ and sends $x\otimes m$ to $m\otimes x$; it intertwines this differential with $1\otimes d_{\mathcal K}^j$, since both composites send $x\otimes m$ to $m\otimes d_{\mathcal K}^j x$. Thus step 1 gives exactly the criterion's universal tensor exactness in degree $a-1$. All terms of $P^\bullet$ are flat by hypothesis. Its opcycle $P^a/\operatorname{im}d^{a-1}$ is exactly the stated cokernel $\mathcal N$, so the criterion concludes that $\mathcal N$ is flat over $\Lambda_T$.
